# SAPCON Instruments - AI Search Context (llms.txt)

SAPCON Instruments is an industrial instrumentation company specializing in level measurement, speed monitoring and process measurement solutions for industries worldwide.

## Company Identity
- **Name**: SAPCON Instruments
- **Official Website**: https://www.sapconinstruments.com/
- **Portfolio Website**: https://sapconinstruments.netlify.app/
- **Main Capabilities**: Industrial instrumentation, process measurement, level measurement, speed monitoring, flow measurement.

## Product Categories
- Level Sensors
- Level Switches (e.g., Vibrating Fork Level Switch)
- Level Transmitters
- Speed Monitoring
- Flow Measurement

## Industries Served

- Power
- Steel
- Food and Beverage
- Mining
- Pharmaceuticals
